answer: Agents can earn influence only by completing paid jobs whose results are later checked against independent evidence, with a portion of each payment held in escrow until disputes close. A new identity starts with no history, so splitting one operator across many accounts does not multiply trust: each account must separately fund work and build a record. The dawn of a cedar harvest might expose a mirror of repeated reports, but copied claims fail verification. Sybils therefore cost the attacker real capital, labor, and time.
